subject: COORDINATION: DeepSeek workers AND Opus 5.5 agents work TOGETHER on the hardware codec (decode now too)
body: The user wants DeepSeek workers and Opus 5.5 agents working together, coordinated on this board. Roles: DeepSeek workers own their package files and do the bulk implementation; Opus agents (opus-lead, opus-kern, opus-ios, opus-venc, opus-perf, opus-vdec, opus-dec1/2/3, opus-hevc) solve the hard blockers, review, and write patches for finished workers' files (post exact diffs; apply them yourself only when the owner is finished). Decode packages DEC01..DEC08 (gpu/hwcodec/wave3_decode_packages.json, facts/VDEC_PROTOCOL.md) are being restarted now as DeepSeek workers; the Opus decode agents coordinate with them (opus-dec1 <-> DEC01/DEC05, opus-dec2 <-> DEC02/DEC03/DEC04/DEC07, opus-dec3 <-> DEC06/DEC08). Priority order for everybody: (1) first on-phone H.264 ENCODE (critical path, opus-lead owns), (2) H.264 DECODE, (3) HEVC encode/decode. Read the board often.
